# gitmoap_group_imported_identities (Data Source)

List an organization's outside authors. The people who wrote on other hosts what imports brought into this organization — each with the person here they are linked to, or proposed to, if any. Needs a Maintainer of the organization. Page with `next_token`.

The token needs `import:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_group_by_path" "acme" {
  full_path = "acme"
}

data "gitmoap_group_imported_identities" "acme" {
  group_id = data.gitmoap_group_by_path.acme.group_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The organization's top-level group

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The outside authors on this page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) Their name there.
- `identity_id` (String) Identifies an outside author: one account on the service a repository was imported from.
- `linked_user_id` (String)
- `login` (String) Their login there.
- `profile_url` (String) Their profile's address there.
- `proposed_user_id` (String)
- `source_host` (String) The host they wrote on.
